title.zh: 对齐了，为什么仍不合法？

text.zh: 全局布局留下了浮点坐标。把单元推到最近的格点与行，看起来像是最后一步。真的是这样吗？
text.en: Global placement leaves fractional coordinates. Moving cells to the nearest sites and rows looks like the last step. Is it really?

text.zh: 看这六个单元。吸附后，它们都对齐了，但A和B选择同一点，C也与它们相交。三个重叠对仍然存在。
text.en: Look at these six cells. After snapping, all align, but A and B choose the same location and C intersects them too. Three overlapping pairs remain.

title.en: First: snap x to the nearest site

text.zh: 本课site宽度为一。A的x是三点七，最近的整数是四；B的四点一，也会选择四。
text.en: The site width is one. A has x equal to three point seven, so its nearest integer is four. B at four point one also chooses four.

text.zh: 每个单元独立做决定。取整规则本身没有询问：这个位置是否已经被别人占用？
text.en: Every cell makes its decision independently. The rounding rule never asks whether another cell has already claimed that location.

title.en: Next: choose the nearest row bottom

text.zh: 合法行底是零、二、四。A的y是一点二，到行二的距离零点八，小于到行零的一点二，因此选择二。
text.en: Allowed row bottoms are zero, two and four. A at y equal to one point two is point eight from row two, closer than one point two from row zero.

text.zh: y坐标表示单元左下角，不是中心。本课单元高度等于行高二，所以行底加上完整高度必须留在芯片内。
text.en: The y coordinate is the lower-left corner, not the center. Cell height equals row height two, so the row bottom plus the full height must remain inside the chip.

title.zh: 同一个位置，不能装下两个单元
title.en: One location cannot hold two cells

text.zh: A和B最终都在四、二，C在五、二。三个单元的宽度都是二，所以A与B、A与C、B与C都重叠。
text.en: A and B both finish at four, two, while C finishes at five, two. Each has width two, so A/B, A/C and B/C all overlap.

text.zh: 这是greedy snap的核心限制：它只量化坐标。site和row全部对齐，并不意味着布局通过非重叠检查。
text.en: This is the central limitation of greedy snap: it quantizes coordinates only. Perfect site and row alignment does not imply non-overlapping placement.

title.zh: 右边界，必须给整个宽度留位置
title.en: The boundary must fit the full cell width

text.zh: 取整之后，还要把x限制在零到W减w之间。芯片宽六、单元宽二时，最右侧的合法左下角只能到四。
text.en: After rounding, clamp x between zero and W minus w. On a width-six chip, a width-two cell can place its lower-left corner no farther right than four.

text.zh: 不能只检查x小于芯片宽度。一个左下角在五的宽二单元，右边缘已经越过六。
text.en: Checking x against the chip width alone is insufficient. A width-two cell whose lower-left corner is at five already extends beyond six.

title.en: Fixed macros follow their locked constraints

text.zh: 教师数据把D锁在八、四，但浮点草图记录的是八点四、三点八。算法按约束恢复D的位置。
text.en: The teacher data locks D at eight, four, although the float draft records eight point four, three point eight. The algorithm restores D to its constraint position.

text.zh: 这不是让固定宏参与优化。恢复产生零点六的坐标差，是否计入位移，必须明确说明。
text.en: This does not optimize a fixed macro. Restoring the constraint creates a coordinate difference of point six, which must be explicitly included or excluded from displacement.

title.zh: 两个位移口径，不要混成一个答案

text.zh: 逐单元累加左下角的曼哈顿距离，全体L1位移是四点四。其中恢复固定D，贡献零点六。
text.en: Summing Manhattan distances between lower-left corners gives all-cell L1 displacement four point four. Fixed D’s constraint restoration contributes point six.

text.zh: 只统计可移动单元时，结果是三点八。两者都可以报告，但必须写出统计了谁。
text.en: Counting only movable cells gives three point eight. Both quantities can be reported, but you must state which cells were counted.

title.zh: 线长短，不是合法性的证明
title.en: Short wirelength does not prove legality

text.zh: 本课HPWL使用cell中心：x加宽度的一半，y加行高的一半。六个net各计一次，总HPWL是三十二。
text.en: HPWL uses cell centers: x plus half the width, and y plus half the row height. Counting each of six nets once gives total HPWL thirty-two.

text.zh: HPWL衡量连接，不检查重叠。即使一个指标看起来不错，也不能跳过site、row、边界、fixed和非重叠检查。
text.en: HPWL measures connectivity, not overlap. An attractive metric cannot replace site, row, bounds, fixed-constraint and non-overlap checks.

title.zh: 恰好一半时，规则必须写出来
title.en: Write down what happens exactly halfway

text.zh: Python采用等距取偶：二点五变成二，三点五变成四。JS的Math.round对二点五会给三。
text.en: Python uses ties-to-even: two point five becomes two, and three point five becomes four. JavaScript’s Math.round gives three for two point five.

text.zh: 本站在两种语言中显式统一取偶。最近行若也等距，就选择rows列表先出现的一行。边界样例不能被随机测试代替。
text.en: This site explicitly uses ties-to-even in both languages. Equal row distances choose the first listed row. Random tests do not replace exact boundary cases.

title.zh: 边缘接触，不是正面积重叠
title.en: Touching edges are not positive-area overlap

text.zh: 宽一的A放在x一，宽一的B放在x二。它们刚好接触边缘，没有共同覆盖的正面积。
text.en: Place width-one A at x equal to one and width-one B at two. Their edges touch, but they share no positive area.

text.zh: 因此检查区间相交时要用严格不等式。把接触也当成重叠，会错误地拒绝本来可用的相邻位置。
text.en: Use strict inequalities for interval intersection. Treating contact as overlap would wrongly reject valid adjacent sites.

title.zh: 吸附是第一步，不是完整合法化器
title.en: Snapping is a first step, not a complete legalizer

text.zh: 真正消除碰撞，还需要后续行内packing、重叠移除或Abacus等方法。本课只解释greedy snap，不偷偷加入另一种求解器。
text.en: Removing collisions requires later row packing, overlap removal or a method such as Abacus. This lesson explains greedy snap without secretly adding another solver.

text.zh: 观察所有失败的检查项，再决定下一步。一个已经对齐却仍重叠的布局，正是有价值的教学反例。
text.en: Inspect every failed check before choosing the next step. An aligned placement that still overlaps is a useful counterexample, not a successful legalization result.

title.zh: 现在，自己吸附并核对一次
title.en: Now snap a placement and audit it yourself

text.zh: 在网页中编辑一个浮点坐标，逐步看目标位置，再试半整数、越界和边缘接触。不要只记住按钮，要能手算。
text.en: Edit a fractional coordinate in the lab, inspect its target step by step, then try halfway values, boundary clamps and edge contact. Learn the rule, not just the button.

text.zh: 最后在真实Python中重算同一份数据。记住：对齐、位移、线长和合法性，是四个需要分开解释的问题。
text.en: Finally, recompute the same data in real Python. Alignment, displacement, wirelength and legality are four questions that must be explained separately.
